Your PDFs are ready

Fresh question pages

Quiz mode creates clean pages without printed answer marks. Each choice links to a color coded feedback page.

Unknown answers

Questions without a reliable key remain in the quiz and show “No answer for this question.” Nothing needs manual review to export.

Compatible PDF feedback

Color feedback works through ordinary PDF links in common readers. It appears after choosing an option on the result page.

Supported formats & conversion details

Quiz mode combines uploaded question banks into one PDF in upload order. It supports text-based PDF question banks with BMJ OnExamination layout, or structured questions with A–E choices. Scanned pages are read with English OCR on your device; large batches can take a long time. OCR requires numbered questions and clear A–E choices, and may misread a poor scan. Some embedded clinical images may not carry into rebuilt quiz pages. Unknown answer keys are labeled, never guessed. Original-layout mode preserves source PDF pages and their printed answers while adding navigation and forms. Digital signatures do not survive modification. Password-protected PDFs are rejected. DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and images remain available in original-layout mode.
